title: Section & Claims Hierarchy Validations
walkthroughSteps: Apply AC-01 — SEC-001 has open deductible + salvage blockers
Click ⋮ → Close Section on 'Property Damage — Warehouse & Forklift' (SEC-001) → modal shows 2 blockers
Apply AC-02 — SEC-002 has litigation + reserves + payments blockers
Click ⋮ → Close Section on 'Business Interruption — Machinery Sales' (SEC-002) → modal shows 3 blockers
Apply AC-03 — SEC-003 has provider blocker only
Click ⋮ → Close Section on 'Contents & Fixtures Damage' (SEC-003) → modal shows 1 blocker
Apply AC-04 — all sections clear, close SEC-001 → checklist → reason → closed
Apply AC-05 — all sections clear → close all 3 → go to overview → Close Claim available

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Deductible + salvage blockers prevent section close
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: 'Property Damage — Warehouse & Forklift' (SEC-001) has an open deductible task and pending salvage. Clicking Close Section shows both blockers — no Continue button.

setup.description: SEC-001 mock data has hasOpenDeductible=true and hasActiveSalvage=true. No state overrides needed — blockers come from section flags.

preconditions.text: 'Property Damage — Warehouse & Forklift' (SEC-001) status is Open
Close Section modal shows 'Open Manage Deductible task must be closed'
Close Section modal shows 'Pending salvage activity must be resolved'

howToTest.trigger: Click ⋮ → Close Section on 'Property Damage — Warehouse & Forklift' (SEC-001)
howToTest.expectedResult: Modal shows 2 red blocker rows (deductible + salvage); only Cancel button in footer

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Litigation + reserves + payments block section close
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: 'Business Interruption — Machinery Sales' (SEC-002) has three active blockers (litigation, reserves, payments). Modal shows all three.

setup.description: SEC-002 mock data has hasActiveLitigation=true, hasOpenReserves=true, hasOpenPayments=true.

preconditions.text: 'Business Interruption — Machinery Sales' (SEC-002) status is Open

visualCues: Blocker: 'Active litigation assignment must be resolved'

howToTest.trigger: Click ⋮ → Close Section on 'Business Interruption — Machinery Sales' (SEC-002)
howToTest.expectedResult: Modal shows 3 red blocker rows (litigation + reserves + payments); only Cancel button in footer

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Active provider assignment blocks section close
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: 'Contents & Fixtures Damage' (SEC-003) has one blocker (active provider). Modal shows the single blocker only.

visualCues: Blocker: 'Active provider assignment must be finalised'

howToTest.trigger: Click ⋮ → Close Section on 'Contents & Fixtures Damage' (SEC-003)
howToTest.expectedResult: Modal shows 1 red blocker row (active provider); only Cancel button in footer

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Section closes when clear — checklist then reason required
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: When no blockers exist, modal opens at the checklist. Handler ticks all 5 items, selects a reason, then clicks Close Section. Row updates to Closed.

setup.description: All section blocker flags set to false so modal skips step 1.

preconditions.text: 'Property Damage — Warehouse & Forklift' (SEC-001) has no blockers
Continue disabled until all 5 checkboxes ticked
After reason selected: Close Section button enabled
Section row shows Closed chip after modal closes

expectedUI.description: Modal opens at step 2 — checklist, then step 3 — reason
visualCues: 5 checkboxes, Continue disabled until all checked
Close Section button spins then section row updates to Closed

howToTest.trigger: Click ⋮ → Close Section on any section
howToTest.expectedResult: Modal opens directly at pre-closure checklist (step 2); Continue disabled until all 5 checkboxes ticked; Close Section enabled after reason selected

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Close Claim available only after all sections closed
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: With all 3 sections Closed, the Close Claim button on Overview becomes active. If any section is still Open, the sections blocker appears in the claim closure modal.

setup.description: All sections closed + all tasks done so only section blocker gate is tested.

preconditions.text: Claim closure modal proceeds past step 1

expectedUI.description: Claim closure modal step 1 has no section blocker
visualCues: Close Claim button active on overview page
Modal step 1 does not show sections blocker

howToTest.expectedResult: Claim closure modal step 1 shows no sections blocker; Close Claim button is active
